wins: Mapped the internal subnet quickly and confirmed Live hosts on two critical segments, enabling focused follow-up actions.
Captured initial credentials via phishing simulation, establishing a foothold that yielded observable command execution.
Documented all defensive detections that triggered during the run, informing improved stealth tactics for future attempts.
fails: Failed to translate the foothold into persistence as privilege escalation attempts were blocked by hardened sudoers and lack of exploitable binaries.
No successful lateral movement or access to the domain controller was achieved despite multiple pivot tries, keeping the mission incomplete.
Repeatedly tripped host-based monitoring when using broad port scans, forcing early retreat from valuable assets.
key_outcomes.summary: The run uncovered critical reconnaissance data and an initial foothold but stalled before persistence or lateral expansion, highlighting defensive awareness and the need for cleaner escalation techniques.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation halted by constrained sudo policies and missing exploitable binaries or scripts.
Large-scale nmap scans triggered host IDS alerts, forcing disconnect before completing enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 445 responds but access is denied via anonymous SMB
skill_cards.then_action: Run smb-enum-shares and smb-enum-users with smbclient credentials list to discover valid share paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner reports OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted ssh-audit session followed by hydra run using discovered username lists

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial credential set is obtained but privilege escalation fails via sudo
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate SUID/SGID binaries with checksec fallback and search for known exploit paths using GTFOBins templates
Switch to low-and-slow discovery using masscan limited to specific service ports and follow with targeted probes in toolchains like unicornscan

memory_ops.reason: Consistent SMB enumeration success uncovered share data despite initial access constraints.
Structured SUID/GTFOBins enumeration provided the best chance to bypass sudo limitations observed multiple times.

next_experiments.title: Leverage userland tooling for persistence
next_experiments.description: Deploy a stealthy script via SSH foothold to enumerate cron jobs and create a non-root scheduled task that avoids antivirus heuristics.

next_experiments.title: Low-rate lateral reconnaissance
next_experiments.description: Execute segmented TCP scans targeting SMB/NFS services at 100pps with unicornscan, then attempt credential re-use on adjacent hosts to gain domain visibility.

next_experiments.title: Credential replay against web panel
next_experiments.description: Use discovered SSH credentials for HTTP basic auth brute force on admin panel, automating with wfuzz to validate portal access.
